## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the issue or Jira ticket.

## Validation

List the checks performed and their results. Include screenshots for visual changes.

## Risk and Rollback

Describe material deployment, compatibility, data, or access implications and how
to reverse the change. State when none apply.

## Review

- [ ] Repository instructions and required checks are satisfied.
- [ ] Required reviewers are identified; sensitive changes have additional review.
- [ ] Documentation reflects the resulting behavior.
